data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that provides an App Store-style zoom tap and long tap animation effect.
data.what_it_does: Zoom Tap Animation wraps any widget to create a scaling animation effect when tapped or long-pressed. It mimics the Today tab behavior found in the iOS App Store, scaling down and back up with configurable durations and curves.
use_when: You want to add interactive scale-on-tap effects similar to the iOS App Store to your UI items.
You need custom animations for taps and long taps with repeated event loops.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion or timelines requiring Rive or Lottie.
You are building a non-Flutter application.
strengths: Easy to drop into existing widget trees as a wrapper.
Highly customizable parameters for scale, duration, and animation curves.
weaknesses: Limited to scale animations on tap/long-tap gestures.
Does not support complex multi-step sequencing out of the box.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_animate if you need a comprehensive, chainable animation library for multiple effects beyond simple zoom taps.

alternatives.name: animate_do
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick animate_do if you want ready-made entrance and attention-seeking animations based on animate.css.
